parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘body dysmorphic disorder’ (BDD).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the biomedical explanation of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between the biomedical explanation of obsessive-
compulsive disorder (OCD) and one other explanation of this disorder.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the treatment and management of schizophrenia and delusional disorder.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the treatment and management of schizophrenia and delusional disorder, including
a discussion of determinism. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘customer focused sales technique’ used for selling a product.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe how the data was collected in the study by Porublev et al. (2009) on gift wrapping.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two weaknesses of the study by Porublev et al. (2009).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about intuitive thinking and its imperfections in
consumer decision-making.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about intuitive thinking and its imperfections in
consumer decision-making, including a discussion of the experimental method. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline one type of non-adherence to medical advice.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Yokley and Glenwick (1984) used six groups with different motivational conditions to compare
adherence to medical advice for child immunisation.
Describe two of these conditions.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one strength and one weakness of an independent measures design, using the study
by Yokley and Glenwick (1984) as an example.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about health promotion in schools, worksites
and communities.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about health promotion in schools, worksites
and communities, including a discussion about validity. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by ‘intrinsic motivation’ in relation to work.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe the hierarchy of needs (Maslow, 1970).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Explain one similarity and one difference between the hierarchy of needs and one other
need theory of motivation to work.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about group development and roles in
organisations.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about group development and roles in
organisations, including a discussion of reductionism.
